en.title: Humming of Rusted Strings
en.premise: As a scavenger, what I stumbled upon was a radio signal from "Dawn Radio"—a broadcast reaching out from a world long dead. Worrying about the dwindling life of my last few batteries, I venture into the ruins of the former capital, chasing the music through the static. What awaits me there is the phantom of a "Festival Night"—a celebration once held by humanity amidst the depths of despair. In a world devoid of both resources and hope, broken machines and human tenacity play one final melody.

zh.title: 锈蚀琴弦的哼唱
zh.premise: 身为拾荒者的我，偶然捕捉到了来自早已死去的世界的“黎明广播”的电波。顾虑着仅剩的一点电池电量，我追寻着那夹杂着杂音的旋律，踏入了首都遗迹的废墟之中。在那里等待着我的，是人类曾在绝望深渊中举办过的“祭典之夜”的幻影。在一个既无物资也无希望的世界里，残破的机械与人类的执念，将奏响最后的乐章。
